title: Incident
description: Shared incident schema for Middle East Grok Bot watch desk

id.description: Unique identifier for the incident (e.g. inc_7f8a9b or UUID)

geo.description: Geographic location or code (e.g. KW, IR, Hormuz, Red Sea, Levant, GCC, QA)

type.description: Incident classification (e.g. missile_strike, drone_intercept, tanker_seizure, gps_jamming, airspace_closure, sirens)

severity.description: Incident severity tier or emoji indicator

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when incident was first observed

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent report on this incident

sources.description: List of source handles, URLs, or news agency IDs

desks.description: List of watch desks reporting or tracking this incident (e.g. kuwait, iran, hormuz)

claim_fingerprint.description: Normalized claim fingerprint / SimHash for deduplication

post_ids.description: Associated X post IDs or post hashes

summary.description: Concise factual summary (no house style headers or emoji decorations)

confidence.description: Confidence label based on source corroboration
